recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the intended FHIR-17763 cleanup in the current core source; no additional core change is recommended for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-17763 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking to remove redundant SNOMED CT vaccine-refusal descendants from the Immunization status reason value set, add all eight v3/C-CDA codes, and keep the Immunization.statusReason binding as example.
initial_application: Historical commit 8386871f82a95342647f6f39d9e145d17dd4f980 applied the composition change by removing the http://snomed.info/sct include and adding PHILISOP, RELIG, VACEFF, and VACSAF to the four existing v3 ActReason concepts. The pre-existing SNOMED copyright/license notice remained in the value set and was later carried forward by metadata normalization.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists immunization=Immunization, so source/immunization/valueset-immunization-status-reason.xml is in current build scope. Immunization.statusReason still binds to this value set with example strength. Later FHIR-54325 wording work expanded statusReason's description for entered-in-error but did not reintroduce SNOMED content or alter the example binding. The CarePlan aggregate status-reason value set was left unchanged because it also includes procedure-not-performed-reason, which still contains SNOMED CT content.
reconciliation: Removed the stale SNOMED CT copyright/license notice from source/immunization/valueset-immunization-status-reason.xml. The value set now has no SNOMED references and its metadata matches the v3-only composition required by FHIR-17763.
source_changes: source/immunization/valueset-immunization-status-reason.xml: removed the obsolete SNOMED CT copyright/license notice from the v3-only Immunization status reason value set.

related_jiras.note: Adjusted Immunization.statusReason wording in the same 2018/2019 work trail but did not affect the value-set composition fixed here.
Mentioned in the same historical commit for other Immunization example value-set changes, but the FHIR-17763 decision is limited to immunization-status-reason.
Later updated statusReason wording for entered-in-error while preserving the example binding and the v3-only status-reason value set composition.
